overview.title: Title insurance and settlement services.
overview.text: Falls County Title Company, Inc. facilitates and streamlines real estate transactions by providing comprehensive title insurance protection and professional settlement services.

services.title: Title Insurance
services.text: We issue title insurance policies that protect against competing claims to a property, so an owner knows the place is held free and clear before the deal closes.
services.lead: How do you know for sure that a homeowner owns the place free and clear, and that they can sell it without some long-lost heir coming out of the woodwork to stake a claim? Title insurance offers protection against any competing claims to your home.

covers.title: A search of public records
covers.text: The insurer runs a title search of public records, seeking loose ends such as liens against the property or fraudulent signatures on ownership documents.

covers.title: Owner's coverage
covers.text: A policy establishes that you can truly take title to the property as the legal owner, which is entered in public records.

covers.title: Lender's coverage
covers.text: There is separate title insurance to cover lenders and buyers, and it is suggested to get a policy for yourself.

covers.title: Clear title
covers.text: Clear title indicates that the property is free of liens or legal questions surrounding its ownership.

questions.q: What does title insurance protect against?
questions.a: Competing claims to your home, such as liens against the property or fraudulent signatures on ownership documents that a search of public records turns up.

questions.q: Does the lender's policy cover me too?
questions.a: No. There is separate title insurance to cover lenders and buyers, and it is suggested to get a policy for yourself.

covers.title: Settlement services
covers.text: We facilitate and streamline real estate transactions with professional settlement services alongside the title policy.

covers.title: The deed
covers.text: A deed transfers ownership of property from one person or entity to another person or entity, and it is recorded as part of the closing.

covers.title: The note and mortgage
covers.text: A note represents your liability for the loan. A mortgage is recorded against the property to secure it as collateral for that loan.

covers.title: Prorations
covers.text: Prorating is when certain fees or taxes are divided to align with the time of ownership between the buyer and the seller.

questions.q: What are prorations on my closing statement?
questions.a: Certain fees or taxes divided to align with the time of ownership. If annual property taxes are $3,000 and the seller moves out one-third of the way through the year on April 1st, they are responsible for one-third of the taxes, or $1,000, and the buyer pays the rest.
A deed transfers ownership of property from one person or entity to another person or entity.

services.title: Escrow Services
services.summary: Funds and documents held until closing.
services.text: Escrow is a holding area for important funds and documents, kept by a representative from the title company while the details of the sale are ironed out.
services.lead: Escrow can be a holding area for important funds and documents maintained by an attorney or a representative from the title company as the details of the sale are ironed out. Once the sale is finalized, the escrow agent disburses the payments and documents accordingly.
services.imageAlt: The entry and stairs of a newly finished home

covers.title: Holding funds
covers.text: Important funds are held while the details of the sale are ironed out.

covers.title: Holding documents
covers.text: The documents of the transaction are maintained by a representative from the title company until the sale is finalized.

covers.title: Disbursement
covers.text: Once the sale is finalized, the escrow agent disburses the payments and documents accordingly.

covers.title: Accounts to suit the deal
covers.text: There are many variations of escrow accounts, depending on the specifics of your deal.

questions.q: Who holds the money before closing?
questions.a: A representative from the title company maintains the funds and documents in escrow as the details of the sale are ironed out.

questions.q: Are all escrow accounts the same?
questions.a: No. There are many variations of escrow accounts, depending on the specifics of your deal. Consult the experts to know more about the salient points of yours.

services.title: Title Searches
services.summary: The chain of title, read and cleared.
services.text: A title search of public records looks for loose ends such as liens against the property or fraudulent signatures on ownership documents, and reads the chain of title to determine clear title.
services.lead: Before a policy is issued, a title search of public records seeks loose ends such as liens against the property or fraudulent signatures on ownership documents. The chain of title is the record of historical ownership of a property, and reviewing it is how clear title is determined.
services.imageAlt: A street of houses in a residential neighborhood

covers.title: Chain of title
covers.text: The record of historical ownership of a property. The title company or real estate attorney typically reviews it to determine clear title.

covers.title: Liens and loose ends
covers.text: The search seeks liens against the property or fraudulent signatures on ownership documents.

covers.title: Clouded title
covers.text: A property with an existing question regarding ownership, chain of title or liens may have a clouded title rather than a clear one.

covers.title: Clearing a cloud
covers.text: Most clouded title issues require a release, court action or legal intervention to remediate.

questions.a: A property with an existing question regarding ownership, chain of title or even liens may have a clouded title rather than a clear title. It may adversely impact the ability to obtain financing or properly record the title.

questions.q: What is the chain of title?
questions.a: The record of historical ownership of a property. The title company or real estate attorney typically reviews the record to determine the clear title.

about.title: A title company serving Falls County since 1870.
text: Falls County Title Company, Inc. is a full-service company dedicated to providing title service to realtors, lenders, brokers and purchasers in Falls County. The company, in one form or another, has been in operation since 1870.

We issue title insurance policies and offer escrow and closing services from our office on Bridge Street in Marlin. With years of combined experience, we deliver friendly and reliable service to all our clients.

faqs.a: Title to a property represents the ownership interest and is designated by the name or names on certain legal documents such as mortgages and deeds. The title can be held by an individual, couple or corporation.
A deed transfers ownership of property from one person or entity to another person or entity.
A mortgage is part of a loan that you take to buy property. It is an instrument that is recorded against the property to secure it as collateral for the loan.
A note is part of a loan that represents your liability for the loan.
Clear title indicates that the property is free of liens or legal questions surrounding its ownership.

Escrow can be a holding area for important funds and documents maintained by an attorney or a representative from the title company as the details of the sale are ironed out. Once the sale is finalized, the escrow agent disburses the payments and documents accordingly.
Prorating is when certain fees or taxes are divided to align with the time of ownership between the buyer and seller.
